feeds.title: The Time Travel Diaries of James Urquhart and Elizabeth Bicester
feeds.description: The Time Travel Diaries of James Urquhart, and his Victorian companion Elizabeth Bicester is a small independent book publishing company based in West Sussex which specializes in publishing books by local authors. It is a place to discuss about time machines and Bruce Macfarlane's science fiction books on time travel.

feeds.title: Lifeboat Foundation Blog » Time Travel
feeds.description: This section of the Lifeboat Foundation News Blog covers the latest news and updates about Time Travel. The Lifeboat Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to encouraging scientific advancements while helping humanity survive existential risks & possible misuse of increasingly powerful technologies.

feeds.title: A Time Travelers Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a log of the authors adventures in time, named Temporal Tales Of Time Traveling Triumph. Also read Blog posts on Teleportation, Fourth Dimension, Cosmos and much more! Michael Remington is a Time Traveler, as an avid history buff, quantum physics whiz, amateur inventor, and optimistic dreamer he conceived of building the time machine.
